Title: Ajay and the Family

Cast

1. Ajay - 31 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Sunita - 55 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The living room - Night

[Ajay stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Ajay: "The night is so quiet."

[Ajay lights the oil lamp in the dark room.]

Sunita (gently): "That's easy."

[Ajay blows out the lamp and goes to sleep.]

Ajay: "Well done!"

Scene 2: The office - Day

[Ajay stands in the office. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Ajay clutches his chest, collapses with a heart attack and dies.]

Sunita: "No… this cannot be!"
